name: Crafting Table

ingredients.name: Wood Planks (any type)
ingredients.howToGet: Place any log in a crafting slot to get 4 planks per log. Punch a tree to get logs.

uses: Unlocks the 3x3 crafting grid needed for most recipes in the game
Place it on the ground and right-click to use it
variants: Only one type exists; the wood used does not change its appearance
editionNote: Identical recipe in Java and Bedrock Edition.
keywords: crafting table how to make craft 3x3 workbench

name: Torch

ingredients.name: Stick
ingredients.howToGet: Craft 2 planks vertically to get 4 sticks.

ingredients.name: Coal or Charcoal
ingredients.howToGet: Mine coal ore (common between Y=0 and Y=320, most around Y=95) or smelt logs in a furnace to make charcoal.

uses: Provides light level 14, preventing hostile mobs from spawning nearby
Marks paths in caves
Melts snow and ice within 2 blocks
variants: Soul Torch (stick + coal + soul soil/soul sand, dimmer, scares piglins)
Redstone Torch (stick + redstone dust, used for circuits)
editionNote: Identical recipe in Java and Bedrock Edition.
keywords: torch light how to craft coal charcoal stick

name: Chest

ingredients.name: Wood Planks (any type)
ingredients.howToGet: Craft 2 logs into 8 planks.

uses: Stores 27 stacks of items
Two chests placed side by side form a large chest with 54 slots
Can be locked with a hopper chain for item sorting systems
variants: Trapped Chest (chest + tripwire hook, sends redstone signal)
Ender Chest (8 obsidian + eye of ender, shared inventory across all ender chests)
Barrel (6 planks + 2 slabs, works under blocks)
editionNote: Identical recipe in Java and Bedrock Edition.
keywords: chest storage how to craft planks

name: Furnace

ingredients.name: Cobblestone
ingredients.howToGet: Mine stone with any pickaxe. Cobbled deepslate or blackstone also work.

uses: Smelts ores into ingots
Cooks food
Makes charcoal from logs, glass from sand, smooth stone from stone
Fuel: coal, charcoal, lava bucket, blaze rods, wood items
variants: Blast Furnace (smelts ores and metal gear twice as fast)
Smoker (cooks food twice as fast)
editionNote: Java and Bedrock accept cobblestone, cobbled deepslate and blackstone.
keywords: furnace how to craft smelt cobblestone

name: Bed

ingredients.name: Wool (same color)
ingredients.howToGet: Shear sheep with shears (1-3 wool, sheep regrows it) or craft 4 string into 1 wool.

ingredients.name: Wood Planks (any type)
ingredients.howToGet: Craft a log into 4 planks.

uses: Sleep through the night, skipping to morning
Sets your respawn point
Explodes violently if used in the Nether or the End - also used as a weapon against the Ender Dragon and for ancient debris mining
variants: 16 dye colors; the wool color sets the bed color (Java allows re-dyeing, Bedrock requires matching wool)
editionNote: In Java you can re-dye a bed with dye; in Bedrock you must craft it with colored wool.
keywords: bed how to craft sleep respawn wool planks

name: Boat

ingredients.name: Wood Planks (any overworld wood)
ingredients.howToGet: Craft 2 logs into 8 planks. The wood type sets the boat's look.

uses: Fast travel over water
Traps mobs that walk into it (useful for capturing villagers, zombies and even the Ender Dragon's endermen)
Prevents fall damage when landed
variants: Boat with Chest (boat + chest, adds 27 storage slots)
One variant per wood type plus bamboo raft
editionNote: Since 1.19 both editions use 5 planks only. Older Bedrock versions also needed a wooden shovel.
keywords: boat how to craft water travel planks

ingredients.howToGet: Craft 2 logs into 8 planks.

name: Anvil

ingredients.name: Block of Iron
ingredients.howToGet: Craft 9 iron ingots per block (27 total).

ingredients.howToGet: Smelt iron ore. Total iron needed: 31 ingots.

Combines enchantments from two items or an item and an enchanted book

Damages entities it falls on
